trace.question: How many parameters does Helium have, how many tokens was it pretrained on, and which dataset gives Moshi its full-duplex ability?
trace.answer: Helium is a 7 billion‑parameter model [Moshi, p.8]. It was pretrained with a batch size of 4.2 million tokens per step over 500 k steps, i.e., using 4.2 M‑token batches [Moshi, p.20]. Moshi gains its full‑duplex capability by fine‑tuning on the Fisher dataset [Moshi, p.8].
